title: MessagingSession - Data API
description: Represents a session on a Messaging channel. This object is available in API version 47.0 and later.

AgentType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
AgentType.description: The type of agent that is assigned to the Messaging session. Possible values are: Agent Bot BotToAgent—Bot & Agent System—Used for triggered outbound messages

CaseId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ChannelLocale.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ChannelType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ChannelType.description: The type of the associated Messaging channel. Possible values are: Alexa AppleBusinessChat—Represents Apple Messages for Business. EmbeddedMessaging—Available in API version 55.0 and later. Facebook GoogleHome Line Omega Phone Text Voice WeChat WebChat WhatsApp

ConversationId.description: The ID of the related conversation. Available in API version 55.0 and later. This field is a relationship field.

EndedByType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort

EndUserLanguage.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

LeadId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

OpportunityId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Origin.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Origin.description: The origin of this Messaging session. Possible values are: AgentInitiated ConversationClose—Messaging user deleted the conversation in Apple Messages ConversationControlLost—Third-party bot resumes control from Salesforce bot or agent Help InboundInitiated OptIn—Opt In Status Change OptOut—Opt Out Status Change TriggeredOutbound Messaging sessions can’t be created using Apex code. They can be created only through customer initiation or by using Process Builder, flows, or the Start Conversation action.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Status.description: The status of the Messaging session. Possible values are: New (standard channels only) Active Consent (enhanced channels only) Waiting Paused (enhanced channels only) Inactive (enhanced channels only) Ended Error (enhanced channels only) To learn more about these statuses, see Lifecycle of a Messaging Session in Salesforce Help.

TargetUserId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TargetUserId.description: The ID of the target user associated with this Messaging session. This is a relationship field.

usage: To monitor messaging session activity, report on the MessagingSession and MessagingSessionMetrics objects. MessagingSessionMetrics captures metrics about a messaging session, such as agent and end user response time. See Report on Messaging Activity in Service Cloud.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they’re available in the same API version as this object.

- **MessagingSessionChangeEvent (API version 62.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **MessagingSessionFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **MessagingSessionHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **MessagingSessionOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **MessagingSessionShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
